description: Current weather, many US points (NWS) — Latest observed conditions for up to 10 US points in one call (lat,lon or label=lat,lon separated by ;): temperature, wind, humidity, pressure, visibility from the nearest NWS station, plus warmest/coldest/windiest, temperature spread, condition mix and freeze/heat/wind/visibility/stale-observation notes. Source: National Weather Service (public domain). JSON. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
